name: @gjsify/integration-debug
description: Integration tests: `debug` (TJ Holowaychuk) on GJS and Node. Validates @gjsify/tty (isatty), @gjsify/process (process.stderr.write + process.stderr.fd), and @gjsify/util (formatWithOptions + inspect format specifiers) end-to-end — the same code paths Express / socket.io / eslint pull through `debug` on every log.

scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
